symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1516: `retrieve $L from $h/M.Line_Header` (from the TO entity Header, the "one" side) followed by `$L/Qty`, `change $L (…)` or `call microflow M.Sub(line = $L)` passed check --references and exec, then mx check reported CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." / CE7247 "Variable 'L' is of type List of M.Line, but should be of type Object."; MDL043 also told `declare $X M.SomeEnum = empty` it was an object declare even with -p.
cause: MDL-RETRIEVE03 (validate_microflow_retrieve_single.go) only seeded database retrieves, because list-vs-object over an association needs the association's type/owner and which end the start variable is; the builder decided it (cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go) but typed an object use leniently. MDL043 ran in the no-project validator only and never asked whether the bare name was an enumeration.
fix: associationRetrieveYieldsList(refSet, ownerBoth, fromToSide), used by the builder and by a new --references pass (validateAssociationRetrieveListUse) that tracks each object variable's entity, resolves the start end via checkAssociationShapes + generalizationChain, and reports member path / change / object-parameter use of the list under MDL-RETRIEVE03 through the walk the no-project rule now shares (walkListObjectUses). MDL043 asks the flow-rule resolver (voidCodeActions.declaredTypeKindOf) and, for a known enumeration, warns with describe's `enum` spelling instead of refusing.
insight: The issue's literal repro (bare list retrieve, unused) builds clean on 11.15.0 as on 11.6.6 — the build failure is only in the USE, so re-measure the reporter's version but expect the defect one statement later than the repro shows. Measured on both: owner Both from the TO side is one object (control), a ReferenceSet a list either way, and `retrieve … where [Assoc = $h] first` the working one-object form. The bare enum declare builds at 0 errors when the project has the enumeration (describe prints `enum`), so MDL043 there was a false error, not just a wording issue. Same name created in both if/else branches is CE0111 on 11.15.0 — Mendix does not allow it; the conditional-create idioms are one create with `if … then … else` values, or a sub-microflow returning per branch.
